text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gasp!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: (――Kyoto is sunny! ☆)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(It's warm! A slightly strong spring breeze!
The scent of fresh buds, soft sunshine,
it's the absolute perfect weather for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
(My body is full of energy! My legs are in tip-top shape!
And my chest is overflowing with excitement and anticipation!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Surely, surely, surely.
I've been waiting all this time—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Today, I get to run the most MARVELOUS
race ever with everyone☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Off I go, MARVELOOOUS!!
choice_data_list: Marvelous!? It's too early for that—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Maaaarvelouuuuus☆★☆
Ahahahahahaha!★☆★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The morning of the Tenno Sho (Spring),
waking up at the inn we arrived at the day before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday was even more... no,
bursting with the most energy she's ever shown.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—It's finally the day of the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
Let's hear from the fans gathered in the stands eager to witness this legendary clash!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Which Umamusume
are you keeping an eye on in today's Tenno Sho (Spring)?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Narita Brian, Mayano Top Gun, Sakura Laurel...
Seriously, talk about an all-star lineup of powerhouse rivals!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
There's an Umamusume we've had our eyes on since the Osaka Hai!
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaarvelouuuuus!☆★☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? Marvelous Sunday!?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-Huh?! Why are you here?!
Aren't you supposed to be in the waiting room...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after arriving at the racetrack, Marvelous Sunday's
momentum showed no signs of stopping,
and she ended up barging right in front of the press!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "It looked like she was in the middle of an interview, and I'd only get in the way. I thought about hurriedly bringing her back to the waiting room, but—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
“—This is the final stretch!
Please, just hold on like this!!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stare back into the eyes turned toward me.
The light in them continues to burst with energy,
yet their color is earnest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Turning back toward the TV crew,
Marvelous Sunday has a serious look on her face."
choice_data_list: Could I have just a moment of your time to talk?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... No, not at all, I'd be glad to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In place of thanks, she gave a radiant wink.
Then, gazing intently into the camera,
Marvelous Sunday began to speak.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Look look☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone, look at me!
I'm fine. I can run. Today, with all my might!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You know, I might not have even made it here.
There were so, so many pitfalls along the way.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"On the bed from when you were little.
At your feet when you train.
Maybe every day, every night, right by your side!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Still, I am here! I'm gonna run right here!
Yeah, I fell into the hole, but I climbed back out.
'Cause outside that hole, past the light, someone held me tight!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run☆ Faster and stronger than anyone★
Watch me, definitely watch me, promise promise☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —And besides, it's not just me!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There's Mayano!
Who understands everything, finds everything boring,
and couldn't find her sparkle for so long――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
However, I found the sparkle I want to become
all on my own!
And I've been running all this time to reach it!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Clever, charming,
and my super-duper favorite bestie!
Mayano Top Gun is here with us today!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Laurel is there too! Just like me, she suffered so much, went through so much pain, and had it truly rough—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, time and time and time and time again,
I endured and got back on my feet!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Kind, stronger of heart than anyone, and the cherry blossom of our pride! Sakura Laurel is here with us today!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Guess what? Narita Brian is here too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Was" the center of an era,
"was" the Umamusume everyone pinned their hopes on—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Brian, who people said was 'washed up,'
overcame her injuries and made it all the way here."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We're running now!
Everyone giving their all, going all out for the Spring Shield!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Yes, YOU!
You watching over there! You listening!
I'm talking to YOU right now!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We're about to run now.
You've gotta watch! Don't look away!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Every single one of them has overcome so much! Every single one of them has pinned their hopes on this!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "The miracle of running in the same race at this very moment! The wonder born from clashing with all our might! The sheer joy of competing together!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna show you
something MAAAAAARVELOUS right now! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: To the world☆ To you★ Straight to your heart☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt—I will deliver the Marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And so, the curtain rises on the big spring showdown.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chan! Fufu, we finally met.
At this very moment, in this race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I saw your appeal from the stands.
Such a wonderful declaration got my heart racing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's run together today. Let's compete.
Giving it our all, at long, long last."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who's going to win, Marvelous Sunday!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Laurel...! Yeah, got it!
But I'm gonna win, Sakura Laurel!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzzzt~!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Both are wrong!
'Cause today, I'm landing in 1st place! That's what I decided on♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, in that last race...
she really showed me what she's made of.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Payback! Absolutely! The ultimate one!
Next time, it's Maya's turn to show off her sparkle!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Way too noisy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let your running do the talking now...
Come on—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Let it boil.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mayano... Brian...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's go! Hurry up, let's race☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started!
Our greatest Marvelous ever!!
